notes.title: A new major Freeland update!
notes.content:
🎉 The Big Freeland Update is LIVE!

Hey Freelanders — we’re thrilled to roll out our biggest update yet, and it’s all thanks to your support and patience! 💛

Here’s what’s new:

🤖 AI Quests – quick, fun, guided missions available on multiple planets

🎟️ Freeland Pass – unlock new tiers, perks, and our first ever Season Pass

✨ Massive polish pass – smoother gameplay, better graphics, UI and lighting, plus huge amount of polish and bug fixes

🧍‍♀️ Avatars and NPCs – completely reworked faces bring characters to life

This update lays the groundwork for what's next: new planets, new challenges, and continuous content drops.

We're aiming high — and we've tied future content releases to subscription milestones. The more subscribers we have, the faster we expand the universe together.  The faster we reach more subscribers, the quicker we will drop new planets!  Our first milestone is 100 new subsribers.  How fast can we all get there?

We have multiple additional planets almost ready to go, but we really wanted to get this polish update out first.

Ready to dive in? Your Freeland journey just leveled up. 🌌

— The Freeland Team

notes.title: Freeland Hotfix: Registration Issues and Exploits fixed, Server Health Improved
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45062732/6fd75c87627b65e58301a4c9f17dc1d229db49d1.png[/img]

Explorers, more fixes coming in!

Thanks to your reports, we were able to fix a significant number of bugs and issues. So let's dive into Freeland's latest [b]server-side[/b] and [b]client-side updates[/b], designed to elevate your galactic adventure like never before!

[h3]New Fixes for New Accounts[/h3]
We've fixed an issue where new players were getting stuck in a [b]registration loop[/b], preventing them from joining the game. This patch ensures that all new accounts can now be created smoothly [b]without any interruptions[/b].

[h3]What about the servers?[/h3]
While our hard-working servers meant well, they ended up being a bit [b]overzealous with restarts[/b] and caused more issues to players. This has been addressed and results in a [b]much smoother experience[/b] while you explore the universe!

[h3]Someone's been naughty[/h3]
An [b]exploit [/b]involving purchases with Orbs has been fixed as it was throwing off the game’s balance. Now everything’s back to normal, and the [b]economy is safe from any cheeky tricks.[/b]

[h3]The more the merrier[/h3]
Good news: we’ve finally got the project into[b] Source Control[/b], and a few [b]new developers[/b] have joined the team! With more hands on deck and everything organized, we’re ready to polish things up and get moving a lot faster. Things are about to [b]kick into high gear[/b], and we can’t wait for you to see the progress!

[h3]One last thing[/h3]
The [b]Discord Referral Raffle[/b] prizes are officially in the game, featuring a brand new dragon mount skin! Winners will receive their prizes very soon, so keep an eye out—we can't wait for you to show off your rewards!


Want to follow up on [b]more updates[/b], engage with the [b]community[/b], and [b]win prizes[/b]? Check out our [url=discord.gg/FreelandVR]Discord Server[/url] and join forces with other Freelanders there!

Freeland HQ

notes.title: Freeland Hotfix: Server Stability, Client Fixes, and Dungeons!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45062732/6fd75c87627b65e58301a4c9f17dc1d229db49d1.png[/img]

You asked, we listened! 

So come explore Freeland HQ's [b]BRAND NEW[/b] [b]server-side[/b] and [b]client-side[/b] patches, we know will take your galactic adventure to the next level. 

[b][h3]Okay, so what are the server-side updates?[/h3][/b]
We’ve only gone and made out-of-this-world adjustments to enhance [b]server health and stability[/b]! These updates should result in smoother gameplay, with fewer disruptions during peak times. Additionally, we've introduced [b]new servers for Prime Meridian[/b] to alleviate lag and performance issues in that region, ensuring a better experience for everyone.

[b][h3]And the client-side patch?[/h3][/b]
We’ve released a [b]stability patch[/b] to address various bugs and crashes on the client side, improving the game's overall reliability! 

[b][h3]Fantastic news! Any quality of life fixes to go with this?[/h3][/b]
Of course! Enjoy the following enhancements to make your time in our galaxy run smoother:
[list]
[*] [b]Starter horse now costs coins[/b], as originally intended.
[*] [b]The Hoverboard now makes the correct sound[/b] when flying, so you can enjoy that sweet hover sound! [i]Woosh[/i]
[/list]
[b][h3]Any earlier fixes I may have missed?[/h3][/b]
Great question! A couple of days ago we also resolved several important issues:
[list]
[*] Login issues and account creation problems have been fixed, making it easier to get into the game.
[*] Dungeons are now fully available and ready for exploration.
[/list]

After all that, all that's left to say is THANK YOU for your continued feedback and patience as we work to create the best possible VR social experience! 

Stay tuned for more updates here or[url=discord.gg/FreelandVR] join us on Discord [/url]for the latest news and support and, as always, see you in Freeland!

Freeland HQ

notes.title: Freeland Early Access Out Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=pCjUCYxzacY;full][/previewyoutube]

Attention, Explorers!

Freeland HQ here, reporting that[b] our online galactic adventure game is now available for download as an Early Access title[/b], and you are cleared for takeoff!

Step into your ships, dare to ride dragons, and discover what Freeland has in store for you.
But you may be wondering, what’s included in this Early Access release? Here’s a comprehensive report on everything you need to know.

- Enjoy hundreds of hours of exploration across multiple planets, including Prime Meridian, Juvu Islands, Time Rise City, Haeyanna, and the Forest Of Myths…
- Meet people from around the globe in our diverse social spaces, or simply socialize with friends.
- Play casually or dare to do something different, competing in races, battling foes in our epic MMO-style quests, riding dragons, and much more! The way you experience Freeland is entirely up to you. 

[h3][b]But what comes after Early Access?[/b][/h3]
Easy there, Explorer. We have a lot to share on this topic in the coming weeks, including a roadmap that will address many of your questions!

[h3][b]What should I do if I need to contact Freeland Support?[/b][/h3]
Well you're in luck! We have a fully staffed station here on Steam where you can leave feedback and suggestions, or [url=https://discord.gg/freelandvr]you can submit bug reports and receive technical support on our active Discord station. [/url]We also maintain a live list of known bugs there for your reference.

[h3][b]Amazing! How can I participate in the celebrations?[/b][/h3]
By joining us on Discord, of course! There, we host regular events, referral raffles, in-game item giveaways, and more. It truly puts the free in Freeland!

[h3][b]Okay, I'm ready! How do I play?[/b][/h3]
To download the game and access our portal, please visit our Steam station linked below, We’d greatly appreciate a review too, to reach new Explorers in the furthest parts of our galaxy.

“Virtual freedom is our highest ambition.”

Alex, 
Freeland CEO.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1705390/Freeland/
